user.title: GoodWe Local Server
user.description: Start a local TCP listener for GoodWe devices. You can configure the listener and optional cloud forwarding after setup.

abort.already_configured: The GoodWe Local Server listener already exists.

data_description.listen_port: Set this to the port your devices connect to, normally 20001.
data_description.stale_after: Measurements become unavailable after this long without current telemetry.
data_description.forward_to_cloud: Send every intact device message to the upstream endpoint. Only recognized replies are returned to devices.
data_description.upstream_host: Use a hostname resolved outside the GoodWe device DNS override.
data_description.upstream_address: Optional public IP address. Leave blank to use the hostname.
data_description.solar_offset_w: Ignore positive solar readings at or below this threshold. The raw CT sensor remains available.

error.invalid_hostname: Enter a valid upstream hostname without a scheme or port.
error.invalid_address: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
error.non_public_address: Enter a public unicast address. Local and reserved addresses can route to the listener.

listen_failed.message: Could not open TCP port {port}. Check whether another service is using it.
